signals.title: Chainguard launches Harness: Claude Mythos 5.1 vulnerability hunting on live app builds, beta waitlist

signals.title: Workspaces beta runs coding agents in remote microVMs with credentials kept outside sessions
signals.summary: RuntimeWire reports that Workspaces, announced Oct 14, 2026, separates developers and agents into remote Linux microVMs with configurable network limits. The preview is not recommended for production. Chainguard is extending from artifact supply into agent execution environments; the security model is unproven.

companies.name: E2B
companies.description: Open-source, hosted microVM sandbox runtime where each AI agent session gets an isolated machine, per its own site.
companies.alignment: Related Scout finding: "Workspaces beta runs coding agents in remote microVMs with credentials kept outside sessions" (radar-scout-b8ba960c4807, radar-scout-7eb521e12a22). E2B offers a comparable isolated-microVM-per-agent primitive. If Chainguard's launch raises buyer attention to agent isolation, E2B may be positioned to benefit. This is a hypothesis, not demonstrated.
strengths: Official site describes per-session microVM isolation and an Apache-2.0 open-source runtime
Offers deployment in the customer's own AWS, GCP or Azure account, per company marketing
companies.uncertainty: Private or early-stage status, funding, customer count, revenue and security efficacy were not verified. Chainguard may compete directly. Isolation claims are vendor statements and were not independently tested.

companies.name: Microsandbox (Super Rad Company)
companies.description: Open-source, local-first microVM runtime and library for running untrusted workloads, including AI agents, CI jobs and plugins, per its official repository.
companies.alignment: Related Scout finding: "Workspaces beta runs coding agents in remote microVMs with credentials kept outside sessions" (radar-scout-b8ba960c4807, radar-scout-7eb521e12a22). Microsandbox offers a self-hosted, local alternative to remote agent microVMs. It may suit buyers who want isolation on their own machines. This is a reasoned hypothesis only.
strengths: Official repository positions it for coding agents, CI jobs and browser agents
Local-first design contrasts with Chainguard's remote Workspaces
companies.uncertainty: Only the GitHub organisation was retrieved. The standalone domain was not verified from an official page. Corporate stage, funding, team, commercial offering and adoption are unknown.

signals.uncertainty: Which competitors offer agent sandboxing or CI attestation, and how do their capabilities compare? None were retrieved.
